# ESP32-C6 ChaCha20-Poly1305 tag A/B, #275 against #280 at 1d8901b8

Five interleaved flashes of fork #275's head `89da51f7` and #280 at `1d8901b8` on one ESP32-C6, 2026-11-22. The tables below are the control image. [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method, the run counts and what each image is.

- Board: ESP32-C6 rev v0.2, 4 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 2C:48
- CPU: Espressif ESP32-C6 (RISC-V riscv32imac), 160 MHz
- Toolchain: rustc 1.98.1 (nixpkgs), riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1
- Control image `ctl`: fork #275 head at the time (26-bit Poly1305 and word-XOR ChaCha20 on 32-bit targets)
- Control runs: 3 flashes (1, 3, 5 of 5)

## rind against the fastest other library (control image)

Below 1.00× rind is faster. Spread is (slowest − fastest run) over the median, for rind and for the fastest other library. The only other library in this firmware is RustCrypto (ed25519-dalek for Ed25519).

| Operation | rind | Fastest other | rind / fastest | Spread (rind, other) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| aead_seal/16B | 62.38 µs | RustCrypto + dalek, 42.75 µs | 1.46× | 0.0%, 0.1% |
| aead_open/16B | 66.00 µs | RustCrypto + dalek, 49.38 µs | 1.34× | 0.0%, 0.0% |
| aead_seal/51B | 70.88 µs | RustCrypto + dalek, 53.00 µs | 1.34× | 0.2%, 0.0% |

| aead_open/243B | 125.38 µs | RustCrypto + dalek, 142.88 µs | 0.88× | 0.1%, 0.0% |
